Review: Build Bonanza Tape - True North Bricks
s: June 23, 2020 - In summary, Build Bonanza tape has no where near the same clutch power as actual LEGO®. However, being able to hold on to 92 bricks upside down is still not that bad for most casual building and play purposes. Using the whole strip of tape, or even multiple strips, you could get quite a structure going. For my purpose of displaying Minifigures, this is an awesome invention. I will probably buy more.
